customer_reply:
Hello, thank you for reporting this. We have identified that your issue is related to an active incident (INC-26-0418) affecting invoice OCR processing following our recent release. Our Engineering team is currently working on a hotfix. 

As a workaround, please switch your affected invoice channels to 'Manual Entry' mode (via Admin > eInvoice > Channels). We recommend holding your month-end OCR batches until the hotfix is deployed, or processing critical invoices manually. We will provide updates as soon as more information is available.

Support Team
